matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Adding the center keypoint together with center pooling reduces incorrect bounding boxes formed by pairing corners that belong to different objects.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Center pooling helps the center keypoints obtain more recognizable visual patterns within objects.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: CenterNet detects each object as a triplet of keypoints — top-left corner, bottom-right corner, and center — improving over CornerNet's keypoint-pair formulation.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: CenterNet detects each object as a triplet of keypoints rather than a pair.

unmatched_a.a_claim_text_normalized: Pure corner-based detection generates many false-positive boxes by pairing corners from unrelated objects, a problem CenterNet's center-keypoint filter mitigates.
